# @zxing/library 0.21.3 (vendored)

`zxing.min.js` is `umd/index.min.js` from the npm package `@zxing/library@0.21.3`
(https://github.com/zxing-js/library), with only the source-map comment removed.
It exposes a global `ZXing` and is lazy-loaded by `js/scanner.js` when the browser
has no native `BarcodeDetector` (e.g. iOS Safari). License: see `LICENSE`
(Apache-2.0, as shipped in the package; the package.json declares MIT).
